parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpc list-cloud-metric-profilings --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
